newsitem.title: USA: Transcend says European patent opposed.
newsitem.headline: Transcend says European patent opposed.

text.p: Transcend Therapeutics said Tuesday that Zambon Group SpA of Italy has filed a notice of opposition in the European Patent Office against its European patent for the use of Procysteine in treating pulmonary disease.
Transcend, in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, said it has only had a short time to examine the assertions of Zambon.
However, it said it intends to respond vigorously to the opposition by presenting additional arguments and facts in support of its position that the patent contains patentable subject matter.

The company noted that an adverse decision by the European Patent Office regarding the opposition may result in the revocation of the patent, designated as EP 0404405, and similar patents in individual European countries.
It could also result in the narrowing of the claims of such patents, which could then have a material adverse effect on the company's business, it noted.
It said no final decision would be expected from the European Patent Office for several years.
